work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed a REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework with OAuth 2.0 authentication (Auth0), containerized with Docker, and deployed to AWS EC2 serving multiple internal gRPC clients; handled authentication, request validation, and service-to-service communication for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

Built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline for policy-enforcement workflows with asynchronous consumer processing and a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for failure handling and manual investigation; ensured exactly-once delivery semantics and improved reliability through robust error handling.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering enterprise compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array operations, multi-stage CTEs, and condition-aware filtering — improving query performance 40% (cutting audit-report generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ resources) and eliminating false-positive findings.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services (SecurityHub, CloudWatch, ControlTower, Shield, X-Ray, EC2, EFS, and others) in production Node.js Lambda functions, reducing bundle size through modular imports and keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 end-of-life.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads; authored 11 AWS log-source plugin tables (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, ALB/NLB/CLB/ELB access, VPC flow, WAF) with standardized error handling.

Designed multi-distro Linux smoke tests (CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS) for Go CLIs in the GitHub Actions release pipeline, hardening release safety and catching regressions before deployment; unified release workflows, automated Slack notifications, and Docker image tagging for four open-source products.

Conducted root cause analysis on a production incident, diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff; collaborated with the platform team to investigate pod logs, service status, and restore availability, implementing preventive measures to avoid recurrence.
